description: Remediates CLAUDE-AUTH-007. The diagnose-with-verifier prompt previously embedded the caller-supplied workspace_identity verbatim, relying on caller convention to keep it opaque. A new `_opacify_workspace_identity` helper at the function boundary now sha256-truncates the value to `ws-<16hex>` BEFORE embedding it, regardless of what the caller supplied. Secrets, code-like content, PII, and multi-line identities are stripped before reaching the model.
purpose: Rung 6 of the Claude authority leak remediation campaign.
